# DiffGraph-CLI (WildestAI)

> `wild diff` — deterministic, offline semantic graphs of git diffs.

## What it does

Wraps `git` and adds `wild diff`, which parses the changed Python code with
tree-sitter and builds a graph of changed modules, files, and symbols with
their calls, imports, and inheritance, including callers outside the diff.
It prints a ranked review path in the terminal, writes an interactive offline
HTML report, or emits a schema-validated JSON artifact. No network access
unless you opt in to AI summaries with `--llm`.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .              # from a clone of this repository
wild diff                     # unstaged + untracked changes
wild diff --staged            # staged changes
wild diff main                # main -> working tree
wild diff main...feature      # a branch's changes since it forked
wild diff -o report.html      # interactive HTML report
wild diff --format json       # canonical JSON artifact
wild diff --llm claude:fast   # opt-in AI summaries via BYOK Relay
```

All other `wild <cmd>` commands pass through to `git` transparently.

## Agent usage

See `skill.md` in this repo for the full agent skill.

For programmatic MCP access, run:
```bash
python mcp_server.py
```

MCP tools: `run_wild_diff`, `list_docs`, `get_docs`, `search_docs`
